dhp197:1: Let us live truly happily, without hatred, amongst those who have hatred,
dhp197:3: amongst humans who have hatred let us live without hatred.
dhp198:1: Let us live truly happily, without sickness, amongst those who are sick,
dhp198:3: amongst humans who have sickness let us live without sickness.
dhp199:1: Let us live truly happily, without longing, amongst those who are longing,
dhp199:3: amongst humans who are longing let us live without longing.
dhp200:2: We live truly happily enough having no possessions ourselves,
dhp200:3: we will feed on joy like the gods of Streaming Light.
dhp201:2: The victor generates hatred, the defeated one finds suffering,
dhp201:3: the one at peace lives happily, having abandoned victory and defeat.
dhp202:1: There is no fire like passion, there is no offence like hatred,
dhp202:3: there is no suffering like the components (of mind and body), no happiness other than peace.
dhp203:1: Hunger is the supreme sickness, conditions are the supreme suffering,
dhp203:4: knowing this as it really is, (know) Nibbāna is the supreme good.
dhp204:2: Health is the supreme gain, content the supreme wealth,
dhp204:4: confidence the supreme kin, Nibbāna the supreme good.
dhp205:1: Savouring the taste of solitude, and the taste of peace,
dhp205:4: he is fearless, faultless, savouring the joyful taste of Dhamma.
dhp206:1: Meeting with the noble is good, living together (with them) is always pleasant,
dhp206:4: through not meeting foolish people one will constantly be happy.
dhp207:2: For he who consorts with fools grieves for a long time,
dhp207:3: dwelling with fools is always suffering as it is with enemies,
dhp207:5: the wise one dwells happily as with an assembly of kin.
dhp208:2: the firm, the wise and the learned,
dhp208:4: * (accompany) such a true and intelligent person
dhp208:5: as the moon accompanies the course of the stars.
